local function isDigAreaPart(object)
    return
        object:IsA("BasePart")
        and object.Name == "DigArea"
end

local function invalidateIsland(island)
    IslandProfiles[island] = nil
    IslandStates[island] = nil
end

local function buildIslandProfile(island)
    local parts = {}

    if not island
        or not island.Parent then

        return {
            Island = island,
            Parts = parts,
            Mode = "None"
        }
    end

    for _,object in ipairs(
        island:GetDescendants()
    ) do
        if isDigAreaPart(object) then
            local ancestor =
                object.Parent

            local valid =
                object.Parent
                and object.Parent.Name
                == "DigAreas"

            while not valid
                and ancestor
                and ancestor ~= island do

                if ancestor.Name == "DigAreas" then
                    valid = true
                    break
                end

                ancestor =
                    ancestor.Parent
            end

            if valid then
                table.insert(
                    parts,
                    object
                )
            end
        end
    end

    table.sort(
        parts,
        function(a,b)
            return
                a:GetFullName()
                <
                b:GetFullName()
        end
    )

    return {
        Island = island,

        Parts = parts,

        Mode =
            #parts >= 4
            and "Hotspots"
            or "Zone"
    }
end

local function getIslandProfile(island)
    local cached =
        IslandProfiles[island]

    if cached then
        local valid = true

        for _,part in ipairs(
            cached.Parts
        ) do
            if not part.Parent then
                valid = false
                break
            end
        end

        if valid then
            return cached
        end
    end

    local profile =
        buildIslandProfile(
            island
        )

    IslandProfiles[island] =
        profile

    return profile
end

local function getIslandState(island)
    if not IslandStates[island] then
        IslandStates[island] = {
            Cursor = 0,
            FailedParts = {}
        }
    end

    return IslandStates[island]
end

local function insidePart(
    part,
    position,
    padding
)
    local point =
        part.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(
            position
        )

    padding = padding or 0

    return
        math.abs(point.X)
        <= part.Size.X / 2 + padding
        and
        math.abs(point.Z)
        <= part.Size.Z / 2 + padding
end

local function getRaycastIgnore(
    island,
    profile
)
    local ignore = {}

    local char = character()

    if char then
        table.insert(
            ignore,
            char
        )
    end

    profile =
        profile
        or getIslandProfile(
            island
        )

    for _,part in ipairs(
        profile.Parts
    ) do
        table.insert(
            ignore,
            part
        )
    end

    return ignore
end

local function groundAt(
    island,
    position,
    profile
)
    local params =
        RaycastParams.new()

    params.FilterType =
        Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

    params.IgnoreWater = false

    params.FilterDescendantsInstances =
        getRaycastIgnore(
            island,
            profile
        )

    return workspace:Raycast(
        position
        + Vector3.new(
            0,
            65,
            0
        ),

        Vector3.new(
            0,
            -200,
            0
        ),

        params
    )
end

local function teleportGround(
    island,
    position,
    profile
)
    if isDigging() then
        return false
    end

    local hrp = root()
    local hum = humanoid()

    if not hrp or not hum then
        return false
    end

    local result =
        groundAt(
            island,
            position,
            profile
        )

    if not result then
        return false
    end

    local offset =
        hum.HipHeight
        + hrp.Size.Y / 2
        + 0.02

    hrp.CFrame =
        CFrame.new(
            result.Position
            + Vector3.new(
                0,
                offset,
                0
            )
        )
        * hrp.CFrame.Rotation

    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
        Vector3.zero

    hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity =
        Vector3.zero

    return true
end

local function randomPointInPart(
    part,
    inset
)
    inset = inset or 0.15

    local halfX =
        math.max(
            0,
            part.Size.X
            * 0.5
            * (1 - inset)
        )

    local halfZ =
        math.max(
            0,
            part.Size.Z
            * 0.5
            * (1 - inset)
        )

    local x =
        halfX > 0.5
        and RNG:NextNumber(
            -halfX,
            halfX
        )
        or 0

    local z =
        halfZ > 0.5
        and RNG:NextNumber(
            -halfZ,
            halfZ
        )
        or 0

    return
        part.CFrame
        * Vector3.new(
            x,
            0,
            z
        )
end

local function getNearestNodeForProfile(
    profile
)
    local hrp = root()

    if not hrp then
        return nil
    end

    local best
    local bestDistance = math.huge
    local now = os.clock()

    for id,node in pairs(
        BuriedNodes
    ) do
        if type(node) == "table"
            and typeof(node.position)
            == "Vector3" then

            local valid = false

            for _,part in ipairs(
                profile.Parts
            ) do
                if insidePart(
                    part,
                    node.position,
                    4
                ) then

                    valid = true
                    break
                end
            end

            if valid then
                local failed =
                    FailedNodes[id]

                if not failed
                    or now >= failed then

                    local distance =
                        (
                            hrp.Position
                            - node.position
                        ).Magnitude

                    if distance
                        < bestDistance then

                        bestDistance =
                            distance

                        best = node
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return best
end

local function nextHotspot(profile)
    local parts = profile.Parts

    if #parts == 0 then
        return nil
    end

    local state =
        getIslandState(
            profile.Island
        )

    local now = os.clock()

    for _ = 1,#parts do
        state.Cursor += 1

        if state.Cursor > #parts then
            state.Cursor = 1
        end

        local part =
            parts[state.Cursor]

        local failed =
            state.FailedParts[part]

        if part.Parent
            and (
                not failed
                or now >= failed
            ) then

            return part
        end
    end

    return
        parts[
            RNG:NextInteger(
                1,
                #parts
            )
        ]
end

local function nearestZone(profile)
    local hrp = root()

    if not hrp then
        return nil
    end

    for _,part in ipairs(
        profile.Parts
    ) do
        if insidePart(
            part,
            hrp.Position,
            1
        ) then

            return part
        end
    end

    local nearest
    local nearestDistance = math.huge

    for _,part in ipairs(
        profile.Parts
    ) do
        local distance =
            (
                hrp.Position
                - part.Position
            ).Magnitude

        if distance < nearestDistance then
            nearestDistance = distance
            nearest = part
        end
    end

    return nearest
end

local function tryDig(timeout)
    CandidateLock =
        os.clock() + 1.05

    setDetectorHeld(false)

    resetDigEquipment()

    local started = os.clock()

    repeat
        if isDigging() then
            CandidateLock =
                os.clock() + 1.5

            return true
        end

        digClick()

        task.wait(0.012)

    until not alive()
        or os.clock() - started
        > (timeout or 0.65)

    local grace = os.clock()

    repeat
        if isDigging() then
            CandidateLock =
                os.clock() + 1.5

            return true
        end

        task.wait(0.006)

    until not alive()
        or os.clock() - grace > 0.18

    CandidateLock = 0

    return false
end

local function tryNode(profile,node)
    if not teleportGround(
        profile.Island,
        node.position,
        profile
    ) then

        FailedNodes[node.id] =
            os.clock() + 0.7

        return false
    end

    setDetectorHeld(true)

    task.wait(0.035)

    setDetectorHeld(false)

    if tryDig(0.65) then
        return true
    end

    FailedNodes[node.id] =
        os.clock() + 0.75

    return false
end

local function tryHotspot(profile,part)
    if not part
        or not part.Parent then

        return false
    end

    local point =
        randomPointInPart(
            part,
            0.3
        )

    if not teleportGround(
        profile.Island,
        point,
        profile
    ) then

        getIslandState(
            profile.Island
        ).FailedParts[part] =
            os.clock() + 0.35

        return false
    end

    setDetectorHeld(true)

    task.wait(0.03)

    setDetectorHeld(false)

    if tryDig(0.6) then
        return true
    end

    getIslandState(
        profile.Island
    ).FailedParts[part] =
        os.clock() + 0.4

    return false
end

local function tryZone(profile,part)
    if not part
        or not part.Parent then

        return false
    end

    local point =
        randomPointInPart(
            part,
            0.1
        )

    if not teleportGround(
        profile.Island,
        point,
        profile
    ) then

        return false
    end

    setDetectorHeld(true)

    task.wait(0.025)

    setDetectorHeld(false)

    return tryDig(0.38)
end

local function searchDig(
    oneTest,
    island
)
    if not alive()
        or Searching
        or Busy
        or isDigging() then

        return false
    end

    island =
        island or ActiveIsland

    if not island
        or not island.Parent then

        return false
    end

    local profile =
        getIslandProfile(
            island
        )

    if #profile.Parts == 0 then
        notify(
            island.Name,
            "No DigArea parts found"
        )

        return false
    end

    Searching = true

    local found = false

    while alive()
        and (
            oneTest
            or (
                Settings.AutoFarm
                and Settings.AutoDig
                and ActiveIsland == island
            )
        ) do

        if Busy or isDigging() then
            found = isDigging()
            break
        end

        local node =
            getNearestNodeForProfile(
                profile
            )

        if node then
            if tryNode(
                profile,
                node
            ) then

                found = true
                break
            end

        elseif profile.Mode == "Hotspots" then
            local hotspot =
                nextHotspot(
                    profile
                )

            if hotspot
                and tryHotspot(
                    profile,
                    hotspot
                ) then

                found = true
                break
            end

        else
            local zone =
                nearestZone(
                    profile
                )

            if zone
                and tryZone(
                    profile,
                    zone
                ) then

                found = true
                break
            end
        end

        task.wait(0.005)
    end

    Searching = false

    return found
end

local function sellAll()
    if Busy then
        return
    end

    Busy = true

    local returnPosition =
        savePosition()

    local snapshot =
        inventoryEntries()

    local sold = 0
    local protected = 0
    local failed = 0

    for _,original in ipairs(snapshot) do
        if not alive() then
            break
        end

        local item =
            findInventory(
                original.uid,
                refreshData()
            )

        if not item then
            continue
        end

        if item.pedestalSlot ~= nil then
            continue
        end

        if item.favorited == true then
            protected += 1
            continue
        end

        local success,reason =
            sellUid(
                item.uid
            )

        if success then
            sold += 1

        elseif reason == "favorited" then
            protected += 1

        else
            failed += 1
        end

        task.wait(0.04)
    end

    restorePosition(
        returnPosition
    )

    resetDigEquipment()

    Busy = false

    notify(
        "Sell All",
        "Sold "
        .. tostring(sold)
        .. " | Protected "
        .. tostring(protected)
        .. " | Failed "
        .. tostring(failed)
    )
end

                or object.Name == "DigAreaMesh" then

        function(object)
            if not alive() then

local function disableOtherToggles(selected)
    ChangingToggle = true

    for island,toggle in pairs(
        IslandToggles
    ) do
        if island ~= selected then
            pcall(function()
                toggle:Set(false)
            end)
        end
    end

    ChangingToggle = false
end

local function startFarm(island)
    if not alive()
        or not island
        or not island.Parent then

        return
    end

    disableOtherToggles(
        island
    )

    ActiveIsland = island

    Settings.AutoFarm = true
    Settings.ActiveIsland = island.Name

    CandidateLock = 0
    NextSearch = 0
    NextGearCheck = 0

    persist()

    local profile =
        getIslandProfile(
            island
        )

    notify(
        island.Name,
        "Auto Farm ON | "
        .. profile.Mode
        .. " | "
        .. tostring(#profile.Parts)
        .. " DigAreas"
    )

    if Settings.AutoDig then
        task.spawn(function()
            resetDigEquipment()

            searchDig(
                false,
                island
            )
        end)
    end
end

local function stopFarm(island)
    if ActiveIsland ~= island then
        return
    end

    Settings.AutoFarm = false
    Settings.ActiveIsland = nil

    ActiveIsland = nil

    CandidateLock = 0

    persist()

    setDetectorHeld(false)

    resetDigEquipment()

    notify(
        island.Name,
        "Auto Farm OFF"
    )
end

        CachedPlot = nil
        CachedPedestals = nil

        resetDigEquipment()

        if Settings.AutoFarm
            and Settings.AutoDig
            and ActiveIsland
            and ActiveIsland.Parent then

            task.spawn(
                searchDig,
                false,
                ActiveIsland
            )
        end
    end
)

local SavedIsland

if Settings.ActiveIsland then
    SavedIsland =
        IslandsFolder:FindFirstChild(
            Settings.ActiveIsland
        )
end

if Settings.AutoFarm
    and SavedIsland
    and getIslandProfile(
        SavedIsland
    ).Mode ~= "None" then

    task.delay(
        1,
        function()
            if not alive() then
                return
            end

            local toggle =
                IslandToggles[
                    SavedIsland
                ]

            if toggle then
                pcall(function()
                    toggle:Set(true)
                end)
            else
                startFarm(
                    SavedIsland
                )
            end
        end
    )
end

    Content =
        ExecutorName
        .. " | Auto Farm feature toggles added | K = UI",

    Duration = 5
})
